mapper.select: SELECT a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, b.FINPROD_ABBR AS finprodAbbr, a.INPUT_TYPE AS valueSource, a.VAL_DATE AS valueDate, a.VALUATION AS valueAsset FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION a left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT b ON a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_TYPE = b.FINPROD_TYPE WHERE b.PROFIT_TYPE in ('01','03') and a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and a.VAL_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{valueDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and a.FINPROD_TYPE='F17'
